# Task Proposal Template

Use this template in your seat's status file under "Blockers / requests" when proposing a new task for `claude` to assign in `docs/TASKS.md`.

---

```markdown
### Task Proposal: [Short Title]

- **Proposed ID:** T-XXX (Claude assigns exact number)
- **Goal:** [1-2 sentences describing what needs to be built or fixed]
- **Target Seat:** [claude | ag-a | ag-b | ag-c | studio-a | studio-b]
- **Estimated Scope:** [Small (<100 lines) | Medium (100-300 lines)]
- **Allowed Folders/Files:** [List specific directory or files]
- **Success Criteria:** [How do we verify this task is done?]
- **Dependencies:** [Any preceding tasks or models required]
```
